constraint.description: Python 3.10+ required for type hints syntax and all subsequent development
Must use standard Python layout with `/src/bet_bot/` package separation from tests. This enables proper package installation and prevents import conflicts.
All code must use type hints throughout project. Enforce with mypy in CI/tests.
From CLAUDE.md: Custom exception hierarchy required. Never use bare except or generic Exception. All exceptions inherit from BetBotError base class.
CRITICAL: API keys must NEVER be hardcoded. Use .env file (gitignored) and load via python-dotenv. .env.template must document required keys.
From CLAUDE.md: Use asyncio for I/O-bound operations. Single global httpx.AsyncClient instance (never multiple). Use semaphores to limit concurrent requests.
CRITICAL: Use httpx (NOT aiohttp, NOT requests). Enables sync/async compatibility with connection pooling, HTTP/2, and proper timeout handling.
From CLAUDE.md: Structured JSON logging to both console (human-readable) and file. Never use print() for logging. Respect LOG_LEVEL env var.
pytest with 80%+ coverage target. Tests in /tests/ with unit/ and integration/ subdirectories. Tests must validate both happy path and error cases.
Use Pydantic models for all configuration. Validate required fields at startup. Provide clear error messages when configuration is missing.

tests.standards: From CLAUDE.md: pytest framework for unit/integration tests with 80%+ coverage target. Tests validate happy paths and error cases. Use fixtures for setup. Async tests use pytest-asyncio. Pydantic models validated with example data. No test should require external API keys (use mocks/stubs).
tests.locations: /tests/ (root directory for all tests) /tests/__init__.py (package marker) /tests/unit/ (unit tests for individual modules) /tests/integration/ (integration tests for component interactions) /tests/conftest.py (pytest fixtures and configuration)
tests.ideas:
Test Ideas Mapped to Acceptance Criteria:
AC #1-2 (Directory structure): Verify all directories exist, __init__.py files present, can import bet_bot package AC #3 (Tests directory): Verify /tests/ exists, pytest recognizes it via `pytest --collect-only` AC #4 (Config directory): Verify /config/ exists (optional in Phase 1, used in story 1.4) AC #5 (.env.template): Verify file exists, contains required keys (OPENAI_API_KEY, API_FOOTBALL_KEY, ODDS_API_KEY, LOG_LEVEL) AC #6 (requirements.txt): Verify file exists, all dependencies listed with versions, `pip install -r requirements.txt` succeeds without errors AC #7 (pytest.ini): Verify pytest recognizes test directory, `pytest --collect-only` runs without errors AC #8 (.gitignore): Verify Python standard patterns present, especially __pycache__/, .venv/, .env, *.pyc, .pytest_cache/
Additional tests: - Verify project can be installed: `pip install -e .` - Verify all .py files have valid syntax: `python -m py_compile src/bet_bot/**/*.py` - Verify mypy type checking configured (run mypy on src/) - Verify no hardcoded API keys in any files
